title: gnaphalium retortum
intro: Gnaphalium retortum, commonly known as button-leaved cudweed, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Gnaphalium retortum include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
